title: How a Man of God Quits Nicotine Without Trading It for Something Else
caption:
Most guys don't think of the vape as a sin issue. It's just there. In the car, on the break, on the pillow at night. But anything you reach for before you think has become your master.

Call it what it is. Learn the moments it owns. Ride the craving out with God, one at a time. And don't swap it for the next thing, because that's not freedom, that's a new landlord.

"For freedom Christ has set us free; stand firm therefore, and do not submit again to a yoke of slavery." Galatians 5:1

Send this to the brother who keeps saying he'll quit after this pod.
